repository_identity.source: exact current-main commit SHA returned by the authorized GitHub connector/API

connector_native_checkpoint.source_rule: Fetch this one UTF-8 Python file from the exact rules_source_sha through the authorized GitHub connector/API and write only this file to a small temporary execution directory. The connector-returned Git blob SHA/equivalent canonical blob identity must be recorded in connector evidence.

connector_evidence.purpose: Small deterministic evidence envelope assembled from exact-SHA connector reads so the standalone checkpoint can validate repository-backed facts without reconstructing repository files locally.
connector_evidence.drift_rule: Immediately before checkpoint/commit, re-query current main through the authorized connector. drift.status may be PASS only when current_main_sha equals rules_source_sha after any required drift refresh.
connector_evidence.media_readiness_rule: Populate status=PASS only from current repository-owned readiness/background evidence. Resolve current media readiness before interpreting replenishment history. REPLENISH is recoverable and must run the shared background continuation procedure before candidate finalization.
connector_evidence.uniqueness_rule: Populate status=PASS only after connector inspection of the profile's current immutable identity namespace. manual_on_demand does not collide merely because same-date scheduled_daily state exists.
connector_evidence.selected_backgrounds_rule: Include only background IDs referenced by the authored pool. For each ID record connector-backed eligible=true, trusted duration_seconds, and the source blob identity/path evidence used to establish eligibility. The full registry is never copied locally merely to run planner-time validation.

invalid_terminal_reasons: no compatible current-format replenishment session exists
allowed_replenishment_terminal_results: DEFERRED_REPLENISHMENT only for a genuine bounded infrastructure wait

durable_review_exclusion.rule: Discovery must automatically exclude every provider asset already present in immutable review-decision state for the same replenishment_session_id, in addition to request-side exclusions.

rules: Audit current repository media readiness before interpreting any historical replenishment state.
If current readiness is PASS, continue planning; legacy, incompatible, unfinished, or exhausted replenishment history cannot block or restart the planner.
If current readiness is REPLENISH and no compatible current-format session exists, create a fresh stable schema-v3 attempt 1 for the same planner invocation instead of stopping.
Keep one stable replenishment_session_id across all replenishment attempts for the original planner invocation.
A rejected visual candidate is not a final planner result.
Persist one immutable evidence-bound review-decision document for each visually reviewed attempt before continuing.
Discovery automatically reloads same-session reviewed provider IDs so recovery does not depend on reconstructing exclusions from memory.
Target only currently deficient categories and rotate or broaden query vocabulary on later attempts.
After approved candidates are deterministically ingested, persist an immutable readiness event from current repository state.
On PASS, resume the same original Daily or Ad-hoc planner invocation immediately.
On REPLENISH with attempt below 5, create the next immutable targeted attempt automatically.
Only a genuine bounded infrastructure wait may return DEFERRED_REPLENISHMENT.
After attempt 5, fail closed with E_MEDIA_REPLENISH_EXHAUSTED and exact remaining deficits; never weaken media quality or visual-review rules.

drift_policy.detection: re-query current main through authorized GitHub connector/API immediately before immutable commit
drift_policy.rules: refresh exact-SHA rules/checkpoint and rerun complete connector-native checkpoint
drift_policy.media: refresh media/readiness/background evidence and rerun complete connector-native checkpoint
drift_policy.history: refresh duplicate/analytics/recent-background reasoning and rerun complete checkpoint whenever authored pool bytes change
drift_policy.operational: continue without restarting creative planning solely for operational evidence changes

blocked_status.name: CHECKPOINT_STAGING_BLOCKED
legal_only_when: exact-SHA connector fetch of connector_checkpoint.py fails
connector-returned checkpoint blob identity is unavailable or inconsistent
the one checkpoint file cannot be written locally
the standalone checkpoint cannot execute with standard-library Python
not_legal_when: github.com shell Git DNS resolution fails
repository files have not been reconstructed locally
the full backgrounds registry has not been copied locally
legacy replenishment state exists or is incompatible
no compatible current-format replenishment session exists

developer_ci_git_mode.rule: Developers/CI may continue using the repository-native planner modules and full test suite from a genuine checkout. This is separate from the canonical ChatGPT/Work connector-native checkpoint path.

forbidden_bootstrap_requirements: reconstructing the repository module tree before planning
copying the full background registry locally merely for planner validation
generic materialization failure after connector reads succeeded
